function esc(s)
    io = IOBuffer(); write(io, '"')
    for c in String(s)
        c == '"' ? write(io, "\\\"") : c == '\\' ? write(io, "\\\\") : c == '\n' ? write(io, "\\n") : (c < ' ' ? write(io, ' ') : write(io, c))
    end
    write(io, '"'); return String(take!(io))
end
script = raw"""for f in /usr/share/Modules/init/bash; do source $f; done
module load python/anaconda3.12.7 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "WORK=$WORK host=$(hostname)"
ls -d $WORK/stade_fw_venv* 2>&1
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv
source $WORK/stade_fw_venv/bin/activate 2>&1 | tail -1
export XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false JAX_SKIP_CUDA_CONSTRAINTS_CHECK=1
env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH python -c "import jax; print('jax', jax.__version__, jax.devices())" 2>&1 | tail -2
which julia; julia --version
"""
out = try read(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -c $script`); stderr = stdout), String) catch e "ERR " * sprint(showerror, e) end
println("{\"log\":" * esc(out[max(1, end - 6000):end]) * "}")
